---
title: "Symptoms"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
symptoms_df <- read_excel("All_symptoms.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
stats_df    <- read_excel("T-test_results.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
```

```{r}
desired_timepoints <- c(
  "Baseline_GROUP A", "Baseline_GROUP B",
  "End Part 1_GROUP A", "End Part 1_GROUP B",
  "End Part 2_GROUP A", "End Part 2_GROUP B",
  "End Part 3_GROUP A", "End Part 3_GROUP B"
)

short_timepoints <- c("Baseline", "End Part 1", "End Part 2", "End Part 3")
short_labels     <- c("Baseline", "EndPart 1", "EndPart 2", "EndPart 3")

y_titles <- c(
  "Total Score" = "FLACC",
  "# of days abnormal" = "DSR Abnormal Days",
  "number of events" = "DSR Total Events"
)

palette <- c(
  "GROUP A" = "#27b85c",
  "GROUP B" = "purple"
)

base_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 10, 5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, color = "black", size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
# Keep only the columns needed for annotation, and standardize names first
stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  rename_with(make.names) %>%
  transmute(
    feature   = feature,
    timepoint = timepoint,
    p_value   = p_value,
    cohens_d  = coalesce(
      if ("cohens_d" %in% names(.)) .[["cohens_d"]] else NA_real_,
      if ("abs_cohens_d" %in% names(.)) .[["abs_cohens_d"]] else NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(timepoint %in% c("End Part 1", "End Part 2", "End Part 3"))

meta_cols <- c("Participant", "Timepoint", "Group")
valid_timepoints <- c("Baseline", "End Part 1", "End Part 2", "End Part 3")

symptoms_df <- symptoms_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group = as.character(Group),
    Timepoint = as.character(Timepoint)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Group %in% c("GROUP A", "GROUP B"),
    Timepoint %in% valid_timepoints
  ) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = short_timepoints))

selected_features <- setdiff(names(symptoms_df), c(meta_cols, "TimeGroup"))
selected_features <- selected_features[sapply(symptoms_df[selected_features], is.numeric)]

long_data <- symptoms_df %>%
  select(Participant, Timepoint, Group, all_of(selected_features)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(selected_features),
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = short_timepoints),
    Group = factor(Group, levels = c("GROUP A", "GROUP B"))
  )
```

```{r}
make_feature_plot <- function(feature_name) {
  feature_df <- long_data %>% filter(Feature == feature_name)
  if (nrow(feature_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  max_y <- max(feature_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_y <- min(feature_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_y)) max_y <- 0
  if (!is.finite(min_y)) min_y <- 0

  y_base <- if (max_y == 0) 1 else max_y * 1.10
  range_y <- max(max_y - min_y, abs(max_y) + 1)

  stat_test <- stats_df %>%
    filter(feature == feature_name, timepoint == "End Part 1")

  p <- ggplot(feature_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Value, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.65), outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(
      position = position_jitterdodge(
        jitter.width = 0.5,
        jitter.height = 0,
        dodge.width = 0.8,
        seed = 42
      ),
      shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.5, colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = short_timepoints, labels = short_labels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) {
      ifelse(x >= 1 & x <= 9 & x == floor(x), sprintf("%.1f", x), as.character(x))
    }) +
    labs(y = if (!is.null(y_titles[[feature_name]])) y_titles[[feature_name]] else feature_name, x = NULL) +
    base_theme

  if (nrow(stat_test) > 0) {
    stat_test <- stat_test %>%
      mutate(
        xcenter = 2,
        xmin = 1.8,
        xmax = 2.2,
        y.position = y_base,
        label = sprintf(
          "p=%.2f%s",
          p_value,
          ifelse(is.na(cohens_d), "", sprintf(" (es=%.1f)", cohens_d))
        ),
        label_offset = range_y * 0.06,
        line_y = y.position + (label_offset * 0.18),
        text_y = y.position + label_offset
      )

    p <- p +
      geom_segment(data = stat_test, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = line_y, yend = line_y), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_segment(data = stat_test, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = line_y, yend = line_y - (label_offset * 0.22)), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_segment(data = stat_test, aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = line_y, yend = line_y - (label_offset * 0.22)), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_text(data = stat_test, aes(x = xcenter, y = text_y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5)
  }

  p
}
```

```{r}
pdf("Symptoms_plots.pdf", width = 7, height = 4.5)

for (feat in selected_features) {
  p <- make_feature_plot(feat)
  if (!is.null(p)) print(p)
}

dev.off()
```
